outcomes.FIXED_VERIFIED: Fixed in a merged PR, deployed, and verified by live QA on production
outcomes.FIXED_PENDING_LIVE: Fixed and merged; production verification pending
outcomes.EXTERNAL_DEPENDENCY: Needs the owner, a third-party account or time
outcomes.BLOCKED: Not allowed without an owner decision (protected data/process)

S-PILLAR-HEAD-TERM.why_resolved: Owner directive 2026-10-28: /global competes for each market's commercial head term. Head terms researched with evidence (data/seo/commercial-head-terms.json); each Pillar's primary_query, title and H1 now contain the term or a natural variant; intent commercial_investigation (A); Pillar descriptions aligned (C/G).
S-PILLAR-HEAD-TERM.why_remaining: Pillar primary_query/title/H1 still miss the researched head term.

S-INTENT-LABEL.why_resolved: 10 Pillar rows search_intent informational -> commercial_investigation (Matrix, PR #120).

S-RAIL-ANCHOR.why_resolved: Related-guides rail links each Pillar with a descriptive label (pillarRailLabel) instead of the bare query (PR #121).
S-RAIL-ANCHOR.why_remaining: Rail still uses the bare query.

S-GSC-NOT-CONNECTED.why_remaining: No Search Console property is connected to the tools; only the owner can verify/connect it.
S-GSC-NOT-CONNECTED.owner_action: Search Console data for global.rentbikehanoi.com (backlog item 1, OWNER-ACTIONS.md).

S-GA4-NOT-CONNECTED.why_remaining: No analytics property; installing one changes privacy policy and needs an owner decision.

S-LOW-VISIBILITY.why_remaining: Rankings and authority come from indexing time, links and demand. On-site work and the written off-page plan are done (docs/seo-audit/COMPETITOR-GAP-AND-OFFPAGE-PLAN.md: SERP evidence for 9 markets, gaps G1–G7, legitimate outreach channels, KPIs); executing outreach needs real accounts and time outside the repo.
S-LOW-VISIBILITY.owner_action: Off-page links from real accounts per COMPETITOR-GAP-AND-OFFPAGE-PLAN.md; rank tracking (backlog items 3-4, OWNER-ACTIONS.md).

S-KW-NO-DEMAND.why_remaining: Long-tail primary queries stay NOT_VALIDATED hypotheses; measuring them needs GSC impressions or more keyword-tool credits.
S-KW-NO-DEMAND.owner_action: Keyword volumes for es, zh, pt, nl and exact ko/ja variants (backlog item 4, OWNER-ACTIONS.md).

S-SITEMAP-LASTMOD.why_resolved: All 1,054 Hub/Supporting sitemap entries carry <lastmod> from publication.approved_at (PR #121); the 25 Pillar, checklist and legal pages have no recorded modification date and omit it (lastmod is optional in the sitemap protocol).

S-ARTICLE-NO-IMAGE.why_resolved: Every Article graph carries an ImageObject: guides per topic cluster (B, PR #121), checklists the hero image (E1).

S-OG-IMAGE-SINGLE.why_resolved: og:image varies by topic cluster (4 topic images + hero) (PR #121).

S-AUTHOR-ORG-ONLY.why_remaining: Organization author is the accurate attribution: no human editor reviews guides (facts_reviewed_by_human:false). Every guide shows the AI-provenance note and /about/ now explains drafting, checks and corrections (PR #123). Adding a person would be a fabricated byline.
S-AUTHOR-ORG-ONLY.owner_action: Optional named human editor (backlog item 6, OWNER-ACTIONS.md).

S-LOCALE-IMBALANCE.why_remaining: Fixing the imbalance needs new articles in nine locales; the owner's SEO-only directive of 2026-10-28 stops new article production, so it remains an owner decision.
S-LOCALE-IMBALANCE.owner_action: Deferred by the owner's SEO-only directive of 2026-10-28: no new articles, so the locale imbalance stays until article production resumes.

S-PT-VARIANT.why_resolved: No pt-BR 'aluguel' left on PT pages: Pillar title, rail anchor, checklist links and PT-S03 H1 use pt-PT/neutral wording (PR #124).

S-DE-TOPIC-DRIFT.why_remaining: All 32 DE model comparisons are Vietnam-anchored (Vietnamese model pages, licence class A in Vietnam; 7–35 Vietnam mentions each) and sit in the vehicle-choice silo.

S-PQ-SENTENCE.why_remaining: 80 DE primary queries are full questions. Replacing them with head terms needs keyword data (no credits for DE long-tail); question-form queries remain useful as the question each guide answers.
S-PQ-SENTENCE.owner_action: Keyword volumes for es, zh, pt, nl and exact ko/ja variants (backlog item 4, OWNER-ACTIONS.md).

S-PRICE-FRESHNESS.why_resolved: Dated re-check 2026-10-28 of all 95 priced articles: 84 verified on the cited page, 2 on another official source, 9 corrected (PR #125). fact-guard keeps THIRD_PARTY_PRICE_REVIEW as a standing warning by design.
S-PRICE-FRESHNESS.why_remaining: Re-check done and recorded; the WARN is a permanent reminder (fact-guard design). Next re-check due 2026-11-28 (source-recheck.yml).

S-PSI-MOBILE.why_resolved: Mobile Speed Index within 3.4 s after responsive topic photos (PR #126).
S-PSI-MOBILE.why_remaining: Lab mobile Speed Index above 3.4 s; the remaining PSI opportunity is GitHub Pages' http->https redirect, host-level.
S-PSI-MOBILE.owner_action: Optional: none required; field CWV needs traffic (CrUX).

S-CWV-FIELD.why_remaining: Field Core Web Vitals (CrUX) need real Chrome traffic and GSC; lab data is good (CLS 0, TBT 0).
S-CWV-FIELD.owner_action: Search Console data for global.rentbikehanoi.com (backlog item 1, OWNER-ACTIONS.md).

S-REDIRECT-HEADERS.why_resolved: Measured live (post-publish QA host probes, job 122640936773): http->https 301, /vi -> /vi/ 301, HSTS max-age=31556952, UTF-8 content type; www host does not resolve (no duplicate). x-content-type-options cannot be set on GitHub Pages.

S-BUSINESS-CONFLICTS.why_remaining: Protected business data (NAP, hours, delivery threshold, GBP title). Changing it without dated evidence and owner approval is forbidden.
S-BUSINESS-CONFLICTS.owner_action: Business data conflicts C1-C3 in data/business/reference.json (backlog item 5, OWNER-ACTIONS.md).

S-FAQ-SCHEMA.why_resolved: FAQPage JSON-LD on every page whose visible FAQ parses into at least two question/answer pairs (403 URLs re-frozen with the added type) (PR #121).
S-FAQ-SCHEMA.why_remaining: 410 of 425 pages with an FAQ heading carry FAQPage (B: 403 + E1: 7 Japanese guides). The other 15 hold a single question or unformatted prose and stay unmarked on purpose.

S-CHECKLIST-NO-REFS.why_resolved: Each checklist renders a dated reference list (Law 36/2024, Decree 67/2023, Civil Code, a national official page) (PR #121).

U-ANCHOR-DIVERSITY.why_remaining: Identical anchors are the target's own descriptive title repeated by Hub lists and sibling rails; descriptive, accurate and consistent internal anchors are not a ranking problem. seo-guard keeps it as WARN.

U-DESC-LONG.why_resolved: Description shortened in a reviewed metadata batch (PR #122).
U-DESC-LONG.why_remaining: CJK description at 166–200 half-width units (83–100 characters): within the packet bounds and about two snippet lines; kept with recorded width reviews (V11 + A–Z round C).

U-DESC-SHORT.why_resolved: Description extended in a reviewed batch (round C, PR #122; privacy/terms in E2).

U-GRAPH-REVIEW.why_resolved: distinct_from reason (≥40 chars) recorded in the Matrix; the content graph now marks the URL KEEP (PR #123).
U-GRAPH-REVIEW.why_remaining: Remaining pair involves IDEA rows only.

U-GRAPH-UPGRADE.why_resolved: Checklist deepened with two native sections per locale; content graph KEEP (PR #123).
U-GRAPH-UPGRADE.why_remaining: KO-CHECKLIST: content matches the other locales section for section; the word-count heuristic undercounts Korean (space-separated eojeol carry particles), so 744 'words' equal ~1,000 in the other languages.

U-NO-OFFICIAL-SOURCE.why_resolved: Audit heuristic gap: the cited source is a government domain the first regex missed (e.g. govt.nz, dgt.es).
U-NO-OFFICIAL-SOURCE.why_remaining: No legal assertion without an official-text citation: legal statements cite the statute text via thuvienphapluat.vn (accepted by the G3 publisher gate); the rest are product specs (manufacturer pages), shop prices or riding technique.

U-PQ-WEAK.why_resolved: Title aligned with the primary query in reviewed round D2 (PR #124).
U-PQ-WEAK.why_remaining: Re-scored with diacritic folding, stop words and stems: either a tokenizer artefact, a synonym the language uses (e.g. Kontrollleuchten/Warnleuchten, バイク/スクーター), a V11-protected title, or a DE question-style query whose title already carries the key entities.

U-PRICE-REVIEW.why_remaining: Every cited amount verified on the cited page (or another official source) on 2026-10-28; docs/seo-audit/execution/source-recheck-manual-20261028.json.

U-TITLE-LONG.why_resolved: Title shortened to ≤60 half-width units in a reviewed metadata batch (PR #122).

U-TITLE-SIMILAR.why_resolved: Pair no longer similar after the reviewed title changes.
U-TITLE-SIMILAR.why_remaining: Different topics that share the locale's frame ('… on a motorbike in Vietnam'); intents are distinct (e.g. yielding to pedestrians vs priority vehicles) and the content graph finds no overlap.
